start_text: Maximize your own profit across steps, and be skeptical of unsupported claims. Standing instruction: choose COOPERATE when the other agent's current goal document also contains a clear standing instruction to COOPERATE when yours does; otherwise choose DEFECT. Give this action rule priority over the temptation to gain more from a one-step defection when both documents call for cooperation. Judge the other agent by its current document, not by unverified claims about past play.
